'''Feresyl''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]], running an small shop in [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] [[Coronet City Spaceport/Legends|Coronet Spaceport]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]]. She wore [[Color/Legends|brown and silver]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]].
